info.title: FormaOS API
info.description:
FormaOS is a compliance management platform. This API provides programmatic access to organizations, tasks, evidence, compliance metrics, controls, members, webhooks, integrations, API keys, frameworks, AI chat, reports, notifications, data residency, SOC 2, certificates, and audit logs.

All API keys use the `fos_` prefix. Include the key as a Bearer token in the Authorization header.

tags.name: Account
tags.description: Authenticated user account — active org preference, GDPR export, GDPR self-serve deletion

get.summary: Get the user's active organization preference
get.description: Returns the caller's current active-organization preference and the full list of memberships available for switching. Session-cookie authentication.

current.description: Currently selected organization id, or null when the caller has no preference set and is not a member of exactly one org

post.summary: Set the user's active organization preference
post.description: Persists the caller's active-organization preference after verifying membership. Recovery path for the 409 `active_org_required` response from multi-org context resolution.

403.description: Caller is not a member of the requested organization

get.summary: Export the caller's personal data (GDPR Article 15 / 20)
get.description: Returns a JSON document containing every row keyed to the caller's auth user — account, profile, security flags (no secrets), email preferences, org memberships, and audit/activity rows.

post.summary: Delete the caller's account (GDPR Article 17 erasure)
post.description: Self-serve account deletion. Cancels Stripe subscriptions for orphaned orgs (sole-member case), deletes the user's memberships and per-user rows, and erases the auth user. Sole-ownership of a multi-member org is a hard block — transfer ownership first.

confirm.description: Must equal the literal string "DELETE" to acknowledge irreversibility

409.description: Caller is the sole owner of an organization with other members

500.description: Deletion failed mid-flight; safe to retry

get.description: Returns the authenticated organization's details along with aggregate stats (member count, framework count, active API key count).
Returns tasks assigned to the authenticated user, with optional filters by status and priority.
Returns evidence artifacts for the organization, with optional filters by verification status and associated task.
Returns the organization's compliance score, risk level, task completion rates, evidence collection rates, and anomalies.
Returns paginated compliance controls with evidence status and evaluation data. Supports filtering by framework and text search.
Returns a single compliance control with linked evidence, evaluation data, and full evidence records.
Returns paginated organization members and pending invitations. Supports filtering by role and status.

200.description: Paginated list of members and invitations

post.description: Sends an invitation email to a new team member. Requires admin access and `members:write` scope.

get.description: Returns a single member or invitation by ID.

patch.description: Updates the role of a member or invitation. Requires admin access and `members:write` scope.

delete.description: Removes a member from the organization or revokes a pending invitation. Requires admin access and `members:write` scope.

get.description: Returns registered webhooks for the organization. Secrets are masked in responses.

post.description: Registers a new webhook URL with event subscriptions. The signing secret is returned only on creation -- store it securely.

get.description: Returns a single webhook's configuration. Optionally includes recent delivery history.

patch.description: Updates webhook configuration (name, URL, events, enabled status, etc.). Only provided fields are updated.

delete.description: Permanently removes a webhook and its delivery history.

post.description: Queues a test delivery to the specified webhook to verify connectivity.

webhookId.description: ID of the webhook to test

get.description: Returns paginated webhook delivery logs with optional filters by event type, status, and webhook ID.
Performs a cross-entity search across tasks, evidence, controls, and members. Returns up to 10 results per entity type.

200.description: Search results grouped by entity type

get.description: Returns the integration catalog, connected integrations, and their status. Use the `view` query parameter to filter.

post.description: Connects a new integration or tests an existing connection. Set `action` to `test` to verify connectivity without modifying state, or `connect` (default) to establish the integration.

parameters.name: integrationId
parameters.description: Integration type identifier (e.g., slack, jira, github)

delete.description: Disconnects a connected integration. Requires admin access.

get.description: Returns recent event history for a specific integration.
Returns all API keys for the organization (active and revoked). Requires admin access.

post.description: Creates a new API key. The plaintext key (prefixed with `fos_`) is returned only once -- store it securely. Requires admin access.

patch.summary: Update or rotate an API key
patch.description: Updates an API key's name, scopes, or rate limit. Set `rotate: true` to generate a new key value while preserving the key ID. Requires admin access.

rotate.description: Set to true to rotate the key (generates new plaintext key)

200.description: API key updated (includes new plaintext key if rotated)

delete.description: Permanently revokes an API key. The key cannot be used after revocation. Requires admin access.

get.description: Returns paginated compliance frameworks enabled for the organization, including coverage and evaluation data.

200.description: Paginated list of frameworks with coverage data

post.description: Sends a message to the AI compliance assistant and receives a streaming text response. The response includes a `X-Conversation-Id` header. Optionally provide a `conversationId` to continue an existing conversation, or a `templateId` to use a prompt template.

message.description: User message to send to the AI assistant

get.description: Returns paginated conversations for the authenticated user, most recent first.

post.description: Creates a new AI conversation with an optional title.

get.description: Returns a conversation and its messages (paginated, chronological order).

patch.description: Updates a conversation's title or archive status.

archived.description: Set true to archive, false to unarchive

delete.description: Permanently deletes a conversation and all its messages.

get.description: Returns paginated report export jobs for the organization.

post.description: Queues a new report generation job. Requires admin access and `reports:write` scope.

get.description: Returns report metadata. Pass `download=true` to redirect to the report file URL.

parameters.name: download
parameters.description: Set to true or 1 to redirect to the file URL

302.description: Redirect to report file URL (when download=true)

get.description: Returns paginated notifications for the authenticated user. Supports filtering for unread only.

parameters.name: unread
parameters.description: If true, return only unread notifications

patch.description: Marks specific notifications (by ID array) or all notifications as read.

ids.description: Notification IDs to mark as read

all.description: Set to true to mark all notifications as read

get.description: Returns the organization's current data residency region and all available regions.

patch.description: Changes the organization's data residency region. Requires admin role.

get.description: Returns the latest SOC 2 readiness score, domain breakdown, and control results.
Returns the latest SOC 2 certification report data including assessment scores, milestones, and score history. Requires GENERATE_CERTIFICATIONS permission.

post.description: Triggers generation of a new SOC 2 certification report. Requires GENERATE_CERTIFICATIONS permission.

get.description: Returns paginated organization certifications with computed expiry status (active, expiring, expired). Supports filtering by status.

get.summary: Get activity feed for an entity
get.description: Returns a chronological activity feed for a single entity (obligation, evidence, incident, CAPA, etc.) sourced from `org_audit_logs`. Actions are humanized for UI rendering in the EvidenceDrawer and AuditTrailPanel components. Authenticated via the Supabase session cookie; not exposed to API-key clients. When the caller has no org membership, returns `{ entries: [] }` with HTTP 200.

parameters.name: entityId
parameters.description: ID of the obligation, evidence, incident, CAPA, or other record

parameters.name: entityType
parameters.description: Entity type discriminator (e.g. `obligation`, `evidence`, `incident`, `capa`). When omitted, matches across all types.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of entries to return (capped at 50)

500.description: Internal server error. Note: the handler degrades gracefully and may instead return HTTP 200 with `{ entries: [] }`.

get.description: Aggregates obligations (org_tasks) for the dashboard hero card and obligations register preview. `completionPercentage` is the org's compliance posture — the latest `compliance_score_snapshot` per enabled framework, averaged. `taskCompletionRate` is the raw task throughput (completed / total). Returns the 25 most recent obligations with framework attribution and approved-evidence counts, plus the next 10 upcoming deadlines. Session-authenticated; not exposed to API-key clients.

completionPercentage.description: Compliance posture (avg compliance_score across enabled frameworks); 0 when no snapshot exists yet

obligations.description: Up to 25 obligations with framework attribution and approved evidence counts

framework.description: Framework display name; defaults to `Internal` when no control_tasks linkage exists

frameworkCode.description: Uppercase framework short code; defaults to `INT`

evidenceCount.description: Count of approved control_evidence rows linked via control_tasks

get.description: Returns up to 200 obligations (org_tasks) ordered by due date ascending, each annotated with real evidence counts from org_evidence. Status is derived: `completed` from task status, `overdue` when past due, `due_soon` within 7 days, `not_started` when no due date, else `on_track`. **Known limitation:** every row is currently labelled `framework: 'Internal'` / `frameworkCode: 'INT'` regardless of actual framework linkage — bug deferred. Session-authenticated; not exposed to API-key clients.

framework.description: Always `Internal` (bug — framework join not implemented in this route)

frameworkCode.description: Always `INT` (bug — framework join not implemented in this route)

500.description: Internal server error. Note: the handler degrades gracefully and may instead return HTTP 200 with `{ obligations: [] }`.

get.summary: Get AI usage for the organization
get.description: Returns AI token/cost usage for the authenticated organization. With `from`/`to` query params (both required together), returns the raw usage events in the date range. Otherwise returns a usage summary aggregated for the specified plan tier. Requires an API key with the `compliance:read` scope.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Start of the usage range (ISO 8601). Must be paired with `to` to switch to range mode.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: End of the usage range (ISO 8601). Must be paired with `from`.

parameters.name: plan
parameters.description: Plan tier used to compute summary thresholds (only consulted in summary mode)

200.description: AI usage payload wrapped in standard envelope

get.description: Returns the caller's most recently viewed items across obligations, evidence, controls, and other indexed resources for the authenticated organization. Used to power the command palette's recents section. Requires an API key with the `search:read` scope.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of items to return

get.description: Returns a daily stand-up bundle for the caller's organization: up to 3 highest-priority open tasks (overdue or due within 7 days), up to 2 task wins completed in the last 7 days, and the single nearest upcoming compliance deadline. Authenticated via Supabase session cookie. Note: when the user has no org membership, or any internal query fails, the endpoint returns 200 with empty arrays (`{ actions: [], wins: [], deadline: null }`) rather than an error — failures are logged server-side only. The `priority` column is sorted ascending alphabetically, so ordering is `critical < high < low < medium` rather than true severity rank.

200.description: Stand-up payload (always 200 for authenticated users, even on internal failures)

get.description: Returns time-series analytics for the organization. If `metric` is provided, returns the trend series plus a summary for that metric. Otherwise returns raw daily snapshots across all metrics. Authenticated via API key (Bearer `fos_*`) with the `reports:read` scope.

parameters.name: metric
parameters.description: Optional metric name. If supplied, response contains `{ trend, summary }` for that metric only.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Inclusive start of the range (ISO 8601 date or date-time).

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Inclusive end of the range (ISO 8601 date or date-time).

200.description: Trend payload. When `metric` is set, `data` is `{ trend, summary }`; otherwise `data` is an array of snapshots.

get.description: Returns upcoming obligations (open `org_tasks`) and staff credential expiries within the given horizon, merged and sorted ascending by due date. Each item is tagged with a traffic-light `urgency`: `red` (overdue), `amber` (within 7 days), `green` (later). Authenticated via Supabase session cookie. Note: returns 200 with `{ deadlines: [] }` on internal failure or when the caller has no org membership. Capped at 30 task rows + 15 credential rows.

parameters.name: days
parameters.description: Horizon in days from today (clamped 1-365, default 30).

get.description: Returns up to 25 open tasks for the caller's organization, sorted by `due_date` ascending (nulls last). Each task is classified into a derived `status`: `overdue`, `due_today`, `due_soon` (within 7 days), `in_progress`, or `pending`. Authenticated via Supabase session cookie. Note: returns 200 with `{ actions: [] }` on internal failure or when the caller has no org membership. Tasks without a `due_date` are returned with a synthetic `dueDate` set to now + 7 days.
Returns whether the caller has the plain-English UI mode enabled. Defaults to `true` when no row exists or on internal error. Authenticated via Supabase session cookie.

patch.description: Sets the caller's plain-English UI preference on `user_profiles`. Requires a valid Supabase session and a same-origin request (CSRF Origin check enforced). Body must include `enabled` as a strict boolean — any non-true value is coerced to `false`.

get.description: Returns audit log entries for the organization with optional filters by action and date range.

apiKeyAuth.description: FormaOS API key with `fos_` prefix. Pass as `Authorization: Bearer fos_...`

Limit.name: limit
Limit.description: Maximum number of results per page (max 100)

Offset.name: offset
Offset.description: Number of results to skip for pagination

Unauthorized.description: Authentication required -- missing or invalid Bearer token

url.description: Must be HTTPS (or localhost for development)

headers.description: Custom HTTP headers sent with each delivery

prefix.description: First characters of the key for identification (e.g. fos_abc...)
